summary: In September 2025, Turek backed conditions on U.S. support for Israel, a position that holds Israel accountable through conditional engagement without calling for an end to U.S. military assistance or naming the conflict a genocide. His campaign platform addresses civil liberties and immigration broadly but does not extend to specific Israel-Palestine policy. The conditional framing places his stance short of candidates who explicitly oppose U.S. military support for Israel.
